tagline.zh: 驾驶哨车守住信标，把一波波掠夺车队挡在砖墙之外。
tagline.en: Drive a sentinel rover, hold the beacon, and keep the raider columns outside the bricks.

desc.en: Finish a run, win or lose.

desc.zh: 击毁第三防区的首领「碾城者」。
desc.en: Destroy the Rampart Crusher, the boss of sector three.

desc.zh: 通关，且信标一次都没有被击中。
desc.en: Clear the game without the beacon taking a single hit.

desc.zh: 通关，且没有动用后备车组。
desc.en: Clear the game without calling on a reserve crew.

desc.zh: 一局里亲手砌下 12 块砖。
desc.en: Lay 12 bricks yourself in one run.
Clear the game with two players.

how.zh: 掠夺车队从战场上方的三个闸口一波波开进来，目标是场地底部的信标。击毁本防区的全部敌车即可过关，第三和第六防区最后还有首领。砖墙两炮打碎，钢板要升到三级火力才打得穿，水面车辆过不去，树丛只遮挡视线；你也可以在车头前砌一块砖。闪金光的敌车被击毁后会留下补给芯片。信标每被击中一次损失一点完整度，同时放出脉冲，清掉空中的敌弹并摧毁贴在墙边的敌车。哨车耗尽或信标熄灭时，后备车组会接手，从本防区开头重来；后备车组也用完，本局失败。守住六个防区即通关。
how.en: Raider columns roll in through three gates at the top of the field and head for the beacon at the bottom. Destroy every raider of a sector to clear it; sectors three and six end with a boss. Brick breaks in two shells, plate only gives way to level-three firepower, vehicles cannot cross water, and thickets only hide what is under them; you can also lay a brick in front of your rover. A raider that glints gold leaves a supply chip when destroyed. Each hit costs the beacon a point of integrity and sets off a pulse that clears raider shells and destroys raiders right at its wall. When the rovers run out or the beacon goes dark, a reserve crew takes the sector over from its opening; with no crew left the run is lost. Hold all six sectors to clear the game.

note.zh: 决定哨车数量、信标完整度、后备车组数量，以及敌车开炮的频率。
note.en: Sets how many rovers and reserve crews you have, the beacon's integrity, and how often raiders fire.

screenshot_alt.zh: 《砖垒信标》局内画面：两辆哨车在砖墙、钢板和树丛之间守着场地底部的信标，敌车正从上方开来。
screenshot_alt.en: Brick Bastion in play: two sentinel rovers guard the beacon at the bottom of the field among brick walls, plate and thickets while raiders close in from the top.

art_alt.zh: 《砖垒信标》主视觉：一辆蓝色小哨车守在砖墙环绕的发光信标前，远处的雾里是成列逼近的掠夺车。
art_alt.en: Brick Bastion key art: a small blue sentinel rover stands guard before a glowing beacon ringed by a brick wall, with a column of raiders advancing through the mist beyond.
